legend: Loosely cohesive tissue fragment of large cells with highly pleomorphic and hyperchromatic nuclei and no glandular or squamous differentiation; subsequent thyroid transcription factor 1 (TTF1) and p40 ICC was negative (Pap).

Large cells in a crowded, discohesive tissue fragment with highly pleomorphic nuclei, abnormal dark and unevenly distributed chromatin, and dense cytoplasm, with no distinct features of glandular or squamous differentiation; subsequent thyroid transcription factor 1 (TTF1) and p40 were negative. There was MET amplification and TP53 mutation present on molecular testing (Pap).

Crowded tissue fragment made up of cells with pleomorphic nuclei with perinucleolar clearing and coarse chromatin, and delicate cytoplasm; subsequent thyroid transcription factor 1 (TTF1) and p40 were negative (Pap).

Large tissue fragments of tumour cells with moderately polymorphic nuclei, chromatin abnormalities, inconspicuous nucleoli, and delicate cytoplasm. No clear features of glandular or squamous differentiation. Thyroid transcription factor 1 (TTF1) and p40 were negative (not shown) (transbronchial FNAB, Pap).
Same case as in Fig. <<#32403>>. The tumour cells appear more polymorphic in this cell block specimen than on the smears (cell block, H&E).
